description: the EXE's last untranslated words: the hint thoughts of the player's room (biorhythm chart, phone, stereo, mascot, manual, button tricks) and a park banner. Promoted into the normal build on the user's request without an on-screen check (only the static checks: draft.py --check, packing, and a whole-set build). Not seen: the room's hint thoughts were not triggered in any run.
